items.title: Meshi Mania
items.text:
Info

A game made in about 96hs during the 2026 GMTK game jam! You are counting down the cost of the buffet until you can make a profit with a limited amount of room in your stomach. Can you beat the entrance fee of the buffet before you have no room left? The claw is also on a count down.

Go to itch.io page
